subject.title: fix: stabilize room-event prompt cache mode

question: Should ambient room_event turns use the filtered safe owner-only core-tool inventory for prompt-cache stability, including owner-sent room events, or should owner-sent room_event turns keep owner-only tools even if that splits cache prefixes?
rationale: Both policies are implementable, but the permanent room_event owner-tool boundary affects compatibility and operator expectations, so automation should not make that product choice alone.

options.title: Accept Safe Room-Event Inventory After Repair
options.body: Keep owner direct turns full-power, keep ambient room_event turns on the filtered safe inventory, and merge only after the Codex dynamic-tool propagation gap is fixed.

options.title: Preserve Owner Room-Event Tools
options.body: Require owner-sent room_event turns to keep owner-only tools and solve the cache split with a different mechanism.

options.title: Pause For A Different Boundary Design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a cache-stability design that does not change any room_event tool inventory.

recommendation.title: Accept Safe Room-Event Inventory After Repair
recommendation.body: Keep owner direct turns full-power, keep ambient room_event turns on the filtered safe inventory, and merge only after the Codex dynamic-tool propagation gap is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently authored the owner-only Gateway tool inventory path that this PR changes for room_event turns.
